tasks.short: Hire, supervise and evaluate scientific staff

steps.what: Hire, supervise or evaluate engineers, technicians, researchers and other staff

tasks.design: Keep hiring, supervision and evaluation with the manager using existing {HCM} and {ATS} records. No separate administrative share or automated staff assessment is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scientific contribution and suitability require contextual judgement and dialogue.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing staff records support the process; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Evaluate uncertain contributions fairly and give useful feedback.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the person and accept responsibility for consequential staff decisions.
tasks.altitude: People management duties and existing authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: The digest identifies employment uses such as hiring and evaluating staff in EU AI Act Annex III; this design introduces no automated employment assessment.

assumptions: Boundary covers manager decisions and conversations, excluding recruitment administration, contracts and payroll processing.

The manager elicits and checks role needs, work examples, candidate or employee responses and contextual limitations within s1. Responses arise during the conversation before its conclusion; no free candidate score or performance flag is assumed.
Existing hiring approvals and delegated decision limits remain; no wider decision authority is gained. Test native staff record access before custom tooling.
Incremental upkeep is zero because tools and management duties are unchanged.
unknowns: Hiring authority and staff evaluation process
research_questions: Is there separately measurable administrative work outside these management conversations?

already_counted.description: Evidence interpretation, dialogue and decision approval

approvals.approved_version: Exact person, evidence considered, proposed decision or feedback, scope and current delegated authority checked before recording or communicating; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0; net=0. Routine supervision and difficult hiring or evaluation cases retain the full management share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design and coordinate phases of scientific problem solving

steps.what: Design successive phases of problem analysis, solution proposals and testing
Coordinate phase transitions and resolve dependencies with research teams

tasks.design: Keep scientific phase design and transition decisions with the manager. {PROJECT} records dependencies and {DOCS} holds criteria, without treating recorded milestones as proof that research is ready to advance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scientific progress can change the appropriate sequence and stop criteria.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing project records support coordination; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Decide whether evidence justifies moving on, repeating work or stopping.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret incomplete findings and negotiate a scientifically useful next step.
tasks.altitude: Scientific coordination and transition authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: scientific phase design and transition judgement cannot be reduced to generic scheduling automation without a demonstrated clerical baseline.

assumptions: Boundary is scientific phase design and coordination, excluding execution and separately counted formal reporting.

The manager captures objectives, dependencies, criteria and uncertainty in s1. Research teams produce phase findings during execution after phase design and before the relevant transition decision in s2. Manager time eliciting and checking findings remains in s2; no prior ready-to-advance flag is assumed.
Use native project views before custom tooling; no change is proposed.
Incremental upkeep is zero because workflow and tools are unchanged. Broader direction under task 7205 must not duplicate these specific transition actions in roll-up.
research_questions: Is repeated status collation distinct from scientific coordination and report work?

approvals.approved_version: Exact project, phase, evidence revision, decision criteria, next action and limits checked before transition direction; changed findings void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+55=100, incremental=0, net=0. Planned transitions and unexpected findings retain scientific design and coordination time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Plan or direct research, development or production activities

tasks.design: Keep scientific priorities and direction with the manager using {PROJECT} and {DOCS}. The broad task supplies no separate repeatable planning-paperwork baseline to remove.
tasks.previous_blocker: Direction balances uncertain scientific value, resources and operational obligations.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing information supports human planning; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Choose what deserves effort when evidence and priorities conflict.
tasks.human_edge: Make accountable trade-offs and explain them to the team.
tasks.altitude: Planning duties and authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: directing research requires contextual priorities and trade-offs; no local time saving is established by document drafting capability.

assumptions: Boundary is broad activity direction, excluding specific phase transitions under task 7207, staff decisions under 7209 and formal reports under 7208.

Teams supply current evidence before relevant decisions; the manager elicits resource limits, commitments, uncertainty and options within s1. No structured optimal-priority flag is assumed; missing facts require manual clarification within retained time.
Test native project information access before custom tools. No new configuration is proposed.
Incremental upkeep is zero because current tools and work remain unchanged; shared management actions have one owner in roll-up.
unknowns: Scientific portfolio and delegated resource authority
research_questions: What observed planning work is repetitive collation rather than direction?

already_counted.description: Evidence interpretation, priority decisions and direction

approvals.approved_version: Exact activity, priorities, resource scope, evidence revision and management instruction checked before direction; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0; net=0. Stable priorities and portfolio conflicts retain the management judgement share; no duplicated phase or reporting work is included.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review activities and prepare scientific operational reports

steps.what: Review project activities and verify report evidence and required conclusions
Prepare research, testing or operational reports from verified evidence

loop.input: Verified findings, approved conclusions, reporting scope and source references
loop.output: Draft report distinguishing observations, conclusions and unresolved issues
loop.check: Manager checks claims, causal language, uncertainty and recommendations against source evidence and intended conclusions
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported interpretations return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Tables are deterministic but narrative synthesis requires language interpretation

steps.what: Review the final report and approve its internal circulation

tasks.design: Draft the report in {DOCS} from a manager-verified brief supported by {PROJECT} records. Keep project review, scientific conclusions and final circulation approval human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Report assembly mixes reusable facts with scientific interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can express approved findings without deciding their meaning.
tasks.still_hard: Expose uncertainty and avoid unsupported causal explanations.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what the evidence supports and what stakeholders need to know.
tasks.altitude: Less initial report writing, unchanged project review and accountability.

evidence.claim: The digest's Novo Nordisk clinical-study-report case describes expert-approved text, model drafting and human approval; its vendor-reported writing reduction is not a natural-sciences-manager task saving.
Model knowledge: the local draft-review allowance and savings are unmeasured scenarios.

assumptions: Boundary is manager project review and report preparation, excluding experimental execution and subsequent decisions already counted elsewhere.

The manager produces source versions, reporting period, selected metrics, evidence references, approved conclusions and unresolved issues in s1; manual reading and capture retain its full 40%. Teams produce underlying findings before s1. No free source-complete or conclusion-ready flag is assumed.
Missing evidence returns to manual clarification; the loop cannot invent findings. Test native reports and document templates before custom integration.
Existing team research and data capture are unchanged and gain no claimed saving.
unknowns: Current report templates, source quality and existing automation
research_questions: Does claim-level review preserve any first-draft saving on uncertain findings?

incremental.description: Report guidance and recurring failure review

approvals.approved_version: Exact final report, figures, evidence links, qualifications and internal recipients checked before circulation; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+22.75+25=87.75; gross=12.25, incremental=6, net=6.25. Range 0-3 allows complex scientific interpretation and existing report templates to erase most drafting gains; project review remains intact.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Bounded reporting support leaves scientific direction, phase decisions and people management with the manager.
reach: Explain study evidence and research-to-production constraints to adjacent managers and coordinators.
role.ambitious_version: A manager who circulates clearer evidence while retaining accountability for people and scientific decisions.
